block.title: push in on an erupting lava cone
block.positive: The camera pushes slowly in toward a erupting magma cone in a vast lava cavern, fountains of bright orange pixel lava cycling up and falling in glowing arcs, the lava lake below heaving and pulsing with rising heat blobs that burst into sparks, long shadow of a passing fighter sliding across the molten surface, embers streaming upward past the lens, rock ceiling glistening with reflected firelight, building intensity as the next eruption loads and fires, continuous single take, no cuts.
